item_short_desc: Rothco’s 5-Piece Aluminum Mess Kit is the ideal companion for camping, hiking, or outdoor survival. This compact and versatile cookware kit includes a frying pan, sauce pan, lid, plate, and plastic cup, all made from heavy-gauge polished aluminum for durability and easy cleaning. The entire set conveniently nests into one compact piece, making it simple to store in your backpack or bug-out bag.
description: Rothco’s 5-Piece Aluminum Mess Kit is the ideal companion for camping, hiking, or outdoor survival. This compact and versatile cookware kit includes a frying pan, sauce pan, lid, plate, and plastic cup, all made from heavy-gauge polished aluminum for durability and easy cleaning. The entire set conveniently nests into one compact piece, making it simple to store in your backpack or bug-out bag. Whether you're preparing a meal in the wilderness or enjoying a picnic at the park, Rothco's mess kit provides everything you need to cook and serve with ease. Lightweight yet sturdy, this mess kit is designed to withstand the rigors of outdoor use while offering reliable performance when you need it most. It's a must-have for any camper, outdoor enthusiast, survivalists, or prepper.
